answer: We formulate a cryptoeconomic primitive using dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect slashing matrices, requiring staking collateral to project identity like a lantern through a prism. Enforcing slashing penalties and zero-knowledge verifiable delay, capital barrier analysis proves the expected payoff of identity multiplication is strictly negative, rendering each sybil a relic. This destroyed adversarial utility ensures robust Nash equilibrium convergence, compelling agents to abandon multi-identity proliferation, preserving staked collateral.
